title: 港府顾问Alan：五年规划如何吸引全球企业？低税与普通法成关键
speaker: Alan

segments.en: It really will internationalize Hong Kong, because we have five of the top universities, top 100, every year.
segments.zh: 这真的会让香港国际化，因为我们每年都有五所大学进入全球百强。

segments.en: And University of Hong Kong insists number 11 in the world. And so, so many people want to come here.
segments.zh: 香港大学坚持排名全球第11位。所以，很多人都想来这里。

segments.en: And really, we never really were, as far as technology was concerned, we're always way behind.
segments.zh: 实际上，在科技方面，我们从来都不是领先的，我们总是远远落后。

segments.en: And this really now with technology, this really gives Hong Kong a chance to really move into the buzzword, which is AI right now,
segments.zh: 现在有了科技，这真的给了香港一个机会，进入当前的热词——人工智能。

segments.en: that everybody's talking about, afraid of it coming, not coming, whatever.
segments.zh: 大家都在谈论它，担心它来或不来，等等。

segments.en: I think David has a question.
So mine is actually quite basic, because I think I'm reminder for our viewers who might not be too familiar.
segments.zh: 我的问题其实很基础，因为我想提醒可能不太熟悉的观众。

segments.en: So we have an annual policy address in Hong Kong.
segments.zh: 香港每年都有施政报告。

segments.en: And so my question is, you know, I was listening to most of what the chief executive said yesterday.
segments.zh: 我的问题是，我听了昨天行政长官的大部分讲话。

segments.en: And most of the content, actually, you would find in an annual policy address, I guess, one part of my question is,
segments.zh: 大部分内容其实在年度施政报告中都能找到，我想我的问题一部分是，

segments.en: how is a five-year version different from just doing the annual address, you know, five times?
segments.zh: 五年规划版本与仅仅做五次年度报告有什么不同？

segments.en: And what is the additional incremental utility to businesses from having something that's more, I guess, longer term looking, I guess, is my question.
segments.zh: 对企业来说，拥有更长期视角的东西有什么额外的增量效用，这是我的问题。

segments.en: Well, I guess with longer term, we're now trying to attract companies, also with tax concessions for different companies.
segments.zh: 嗯，从长期来看，我们现在试图吸引公司，也为不同公司提供税收优惠。

segments.en: So it gives Hong Kong a chance to attract outside companies who really wanted to take part in this, the growth of China, the growth of Hong Kong at the moment,
segments.zh: 所以这给了香港一个机会，吸引那些真正想参与中国增长、香港增长的外部公司，

segments.en: the internationalism that Hong Kong has a low tax base that we have, and so the common law system.
segments.zh: 香港的国际化、我们拥有的低税基，以及普通法体系。

segments.en: So I think that really gives us a chance to really attract different companies.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这真的给了我们一个机会，真正吸引不同的公司。
